references.text: Israel struck down Midian and killed all the men, including the kings. This shows a similar pattern of complete victory over the enemy.
Israel struck down Moab at the Jordan and killed twelve thousand men. The same geographic area and a similar military victory.
Joshua defeated the kings and hanged them. It illustrates the pattern of total victory where none escaped.
Barak pursued Sisera's army, and the entire army fell by the sword; not one man was left. The same expression that no one escaped.
The Israelites killed the Midianite princes Oreb and Zeeb. Another example of Israel's victory over enemies in the book of Judges.
About one hundred and twenty thousand men from the army of the easterners had fallen. It shows similar military statistics regarding enemy casualties.
Saul waged war against Moab and other enemies and was victorious. A continuation of Israel's struggle against Moab.
David struck down Moab and measured them with a cord to determine who would live and who would die. This illustrates Israel's later victories over Moab.
